name: Sany Heavy Industry Co.,Ltd
summary: Sany Heavy Industry Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of construction machinery in Chinese mainland and internationally. It operates through six segments: Concrete Machinery, Excavating Machinery, Hoisting Machinery, Piling Machinery, Road Machinery, and Financial Services. The company offers concrete pump trucks, concrete delivery pumps, and wall grabs; truck mounted concrete, trailer, and line pump, as well as placing boom, truck mixer, and batching plant; and excavator, such as mini, small, medium, large, long-reach, and wheel excavators.
